text:
It's you again!
How can I help you?
zh:
又是你啊！
有什么可以效劳的？

text: Do you have something to sell?
Where do I get a capital permit?
zh: 我在哪儿能弄到王都的通行证？

text: Here's a little something for helping me out.
zh: 这是谢你帮忙的小小心意。

text:
This is a little trinket amongst traders.
May it serve you well.
zh:
这是我们商人之间流传的小玩意儿。
愿它对你有用。

text:
I think Glen has one to offer.
You better ask him about that.
zh:
我记得格伦手里有一张。
这事你最好去问他。

text: Be sure to come back and have a look at my wares sometime!
zh: 记得改天回来看看我的货！
